info.title: Snipp.gg Relay API
info.description: First-party Snipp API for the full user experience: uploads, posts, discover, likes, comments, notifications, blocks and profile management.

servers.description: Default. Load-balanced across regions. No upload cap.
EU West regional endpoint. Pins uploads and storage to EU West.
US West regional endpoint. Pins uploads and storage to US West.
Alternative host. Capped at 100 MB per upload.

get.description: Fetch a user profile. Pass `@me` or your own ID for your full account, including keys and limits.

patch.description: Update your own profile. `id` must be `@me` or your own ID. Send only the fields you want to change.

get.description: List a user's public posts, newest first. Unlisted, private, draft, team, moderated and restricted posts are never included.

post.description: Report a user to the moderation team.
Upload a new avatar. PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF up to 30 MB. `id` must be `@me` or your own ID.

delete.description: Remove your avatar. `id` must be `@me` or your own ID.

post.description: Upload a new banner. PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF up to 30 MB. `id` must be `@me` or your own ID.

delete.description: Remove your banner. `id` must be `@me` or your own ID.

post.description: Follow a user. Following someone you already follow succeeds.

follower_count.description: The target's follower count after the call.

delete.description: Stop following a user. Unfollowing someone you do not follow succeeds.

follower_count.description: The target's follower count after the call.

delete.description: Remove a user from your followers. `id` must be `@me` or your own ID.

get.description: List the users following a profile, newest first.
List the users a profile follows, newest first.

post.description: Block a user. Also removes any follow between you, both ways.

delete.description: Unblock a user. Unblocking someone you do not block succeeds.

get.description: List the users you block, newest first. `id` must be `@me` or your own ID.

post.description: Upload 1 to 50 images or videos. Every upload creates a post. Two or more files form one album unless `post-type: individual` is sent.

parameters.name: post-type
parameters.description: `album` or `individual`. Only matters for two or more files.

url.description: Direct URL of the first file (`post.files[0].url`).

individual.summary: Individual posts with a failed file

get.description: List your personal posts, newest first. Requires gallery access on the key.
Fetch a post by its share code.

patch.description: Change a post's title, description or privacy. Relay also accepts `priority` and `access`.

priority.description: Turn priority streaming on or off for the post's videos.

access.description: Usernames who can open the post while private. Replaces the list.

delete.description: Delete a post and every file in it.

post.description: Add files to an existing post. Posts hold up to 50 files.

file.description: One or more files. Repeat the `file` field.

delete.description: Remove one file from a post. Removing the last file deletes the post.

post.description: Report a post to the moderation team.
Like a post. Liking twice keeps it liked.

delete.description: Remove your like. Unliking a post you have not liked succeeds.

get.description: List a post's comments, oldest first.

delete.description: Delete a comment. The comment's author and the post's owner can delete it.

post.description: Like a comment. Liking twice keeps it liked.

delete.description: Remove your like from a comment.

post.description: Report a comment to the moderation team.

get.description: Up to 50 recent public posts in random order.
List your notifications, newest first, with likes and follows grouped.

post.description: Mark every unread notification as read.

get.description: Read your notification, email, upload and sharing preferences.

patch.description: Change any subset of your preferences.

get.description: List the devices signed in to your account on the website.
Public posts whose first file is a GIF, newest first. No key required.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words to match at word starts in the title or description. Up to 6 words.

post.description: Convert one image or video and get the converted bytes back. Nothing is stored.

200.description: The converted file, sent as an attachment.

get.description: The region that served the request. No key required.
Your daily upload activity for the last 365 days, with summary stats.
Your analytics over time plus totals. Snipp+ only.

message.description: Human-readable sentence. Do not match on it; use `type`.

username.description: `suspended` on `GET /users/{id}` only: the suspended user's username.

quota.description: `quota_exceeded` only: the limit, in bytes for the weekly quota or minutes for priority minutes.

used.description: `quota_exceeded` only: usage in the current window, in the same unit as `quota`.

index.description: Zero-based position of the file in the request.

FailedFile.description: A file that was not stored. `error` has the same shape as a top-level error.

Error.description: Every non-2xx response has this body.

UserRef.description: A user embedded inside another resource.

CustomEmbed.description: Custom embed settings. Keys are omitted when unset.

bug_hunter_tier.description: `0` none, `1` Bug Hunter, `2` Elite Bug Hunter.

following.description: You follow this user. `false` on your own profile.

blocking.description: You block this user. `false` on your own profile.

resets_at.description: When the window resets. `null` before your first upload or stream.

Limits.description: `usage` is the weekly upload quota in bytes. `priority_minutes` is the 30-day priority streaming budget in minutes.

status.description: `active`, `trialing`, `past_due`, `canceled` and other billing states, or `gifted`. `null` on Free.

key_has_uploads_access.description: Whether the API key has gallery access.

upload_count.description: Number of stored files in your personal gallery.

theme.description: Your accent theme, or `null` when unset.

SelfUser.description: Returned for `@me` or your own ID.

name.description: Stored file name: 32 hex characters plus an extension.

url.description: Direct file URL. Signed for 24 hours on private posts.

priority.description: At least one video is on priority (adaptive) streaming.

team_id.description: Team ID for team posts, otherwise `null`.

liked.description: You liked the post. `null` on team posts.

moderated.description: Owner only. Omitted for everyone else.

restricted.description: Owner only. Omitted for everyone else.

suspended.description: True while that account is suspended. Show the entry dimmed; nothing about the access changes and it returns to normal on unsuspension.

access.description: Owner of a personal post only, on `GET` and `PATCH /posts/{code}`: users who can open it while private.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. `null` on the last page.

amount.description: Estimated payout in USD for the current period.

type.description: `follow`, `like`, `comment`, `comment_like`, `mention`, `post_shared`, or a system type such as `post_auto_moderated` or `report_received`.

share_policy.description: Who can give you access to their private posts. `following` means only accounts you follow. Changing it does not remove access you already have.

UserId.name: id
UserId.description: User ID, or `@me` for your own account.

IncludeMetadata.name: include-metadata
IncludeMetadata.description: `true` keeps file metadata. Omitted or `false` strips it.

Priority.name: priority
Priority.description: `false` opts videos out of priority (adaptive) streaming.

FollowerId.name: follower_id
FollowerId.description: ID of the follower to remove.

RequestId.description: Unique ID for the request. Include it when contacting support.
